categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu New Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive parts industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of automotive components. Its main product lines include suspension and damping systems, powertrain and related systems, interior and exterior systems, three-electric systems (electric drive, battery, and control), automation and molds, and new materials. The company also provides related services such as polyurethane cutting and embedded component assembly.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including aluminum alloy die casting, precision injection molding and blow molding, chassis damping bushing processing, surface treatment, and mold development. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as high-pressure/low-pressure casting, heat treatment, machining, assembly automation, and cleanroom production for electric drive components. The firm also develops proprietary molds and automated production lines, integrating digital manufacturing execution systems (MES) and business intelligence (BI) for process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: NTG serves leading automotive OEMs and tier-1 suppliers domestically and internationally, including brands like Geely, Chery, Volkswagen, Honda, Toyota, SAIC, FAW, Mazda, General Motors, Ford, BYD, XPeng, NIO, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and others. Its products are integrated into suspension, steering, and three-electric systems for both traditional and new energy vehicles. The company also targets emerging markets in automotive electrification, intelligent vehicles, and lightweight materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Huai'an, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its global footprint by establishing a subsidiary in Germany (NTG Europe) and forming an investment and M&A team in Shanghai to deepen cooperation with European partners and expand into global markets including Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: NTG operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a tier-1 and tier-2 supplier specializing in the manufacturing of automotive components and modules. It provides integrated solutions from mold design and production to component manufacturing and assembly, supporting OEMs and tier-1 suppliers with lightweight automotive parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on automotive electrification, intelligentization, and lightweighting. It prioritizes R&D investment to enhance core technologies in aluminum alloy and plastic lightweight components, electric drive systems, and new materials such as 5N high-purity aluminum. NTG also emphasizes digital transformation, automation, and global expansion, alongside strategic investments and acquisitions to strengthen its industrial chain and innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: NTG generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive parts and components to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers. Its income derives from product sales, including suspension systems, powertrain components, interior/exterior parts, and three-electric system parts. The company also earns revenue from mold manufacturing and related automotive processing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Operating in a highly competitive automotive parts market with a low concentration ratio (CR5 of 4%-6%), NTG positions itself as a core domestic supplier in automotive lightweighting. It competes with global and domestic automotive parts manufacturers by leveraging its multi-technology integration, strong R&D, and broad customer base. The company has established a solid reputation among leading global OEMs and tier-1 suppliers, securing long-term partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, NTG achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 975 million, representing an 8.01% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 53.6 million, a 26.2% decrease due to rising raw material costs and increased expenses. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.72 billion with steady growth in equity and ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades. R&D expenditure accounted for 5.85% of revenue, reflecting a growing innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NTG emphasizes its comprehensive lightweighting solutions combining aluminum alloy die casting and plastic molding technologies, supported by proprietary mold design and automated production lines. Its value proposition lies in delivering high-quality, lightweight automotive components that meet stringent safety and performance standards, enabling OEMs to achieve energy efficiency and emissions reduction targets. The company’s integrated technology platform, strong customer collaboration, and continuous innovation differentiate it in the automotive supply chain.
